CobbleMain.title: TECH COMPANY #3
CobbleMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #3
to renovate a house.
CobbleMain.rewardText: Well done! There are {{actorCounts.CobbleHouse - 1}} other houses to find on the islands. Renovate them to unlock more Data B-each Points.

TrailMain.title: TECH COMPANY #1
TrailMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #1
and participate in a
bike race.
TrailMain.rewardText: Congratulations! Come back anytime and finish your lap in less than {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}} seconds to unlock more Data B-each Points.

PylonMain.title: TECH COMPANY #8
PylonMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #8
to build the bridge.
PylonMain.rewardText: Nice! Keep your eyes open, there are chests on the island, next to the house.

SalveMain.title: TECH COMPANY #9
SalveMain.description:
Talk with TECH COMPANY #9,
and aid someone in pain.
SalveMain.rewardText: So nice! There is {{actorCounts.CitizenSick - 1}} other people that need assistance on the islands. Help them and you'll be rewarded with more Data B-each Points!

TrailSide.title: Bike Race
TrailSide.description: Complete the bike race in under {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}}s.
TrailSide.rewardText: Complete the bike race in under {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}}s.

SalveSide.title: Help people in pain
SalveSide.description: Help all the people in pain

HAVE YOU SEEN WHAT THE Glorbs found!
WE NEED your help restoring the power back on the island, CAN YOU HELP US!!
OK OK OK OK OK
Hello world
Hi there! Did you know TECH COMPANY #3 can help finance your next big home improvement?
Great! We're going to renovate some houses on the island with TECH COMPANY #3's help.
Take this hammer and help us finish the job.
There are several around here that need some fixing!
Hey! Don't forget about us, let's apply the finishing touch to these houses.
Great work, thanks! Go ahead and keep the hammer...
there are houses in need of upgrades all over the island.
Do you own your own home? TECH COMPANY #3 can help you secure a competitive interest rate on your player cards.
Want to find out how?
TECH COMPANY #3 offers player cards that uses the equity from your home.
Use it on home improvement projects or other large purchases.
It's easy, fast, and simple.
No problem! If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
Come check us out!
Ahhh... Much better! Thanks, friend!
Good to see you again. Want to learn more about TECH COMPANY #3?
At TECH COMPANY #3, we're on a mission to reduce player cards interest rates by using your home equity.
No problem. Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
Come check us out!
Congratulations! Of all the handy workers on the island, you're the handiest!
Thanks for fixing that bridge! I've been stuck here for ages...
As a show of thanks, I'll tell you a secret... There's treasure on this island...
There are plenty of other secrets to discover around the island.
Did you know there are hidden treasures all over this island?
And just because I like you, I'm gonna let you in on where one of those treasures is buried...
Interested?
Hmm?
Well... Alright then!
I saw one hidden on the beach at the top of the village.
With all the Data B-each Points I collected, I was able to unlock enough equipment to go to the moon!
Check your phone to see what you've unlocked!
HELP!!! SHE'S DROWNING!!!
Oh, I was way off! She's just swimming nearby...
Perhaps she hasn't heard that there are boats at each island to help you move around quickly.
We should probably tell her!
MISSING DIALOG
I'm so happy! I'm about to buy the bike of my dreams. Want to know how I did it?
Daily routine! Because managing your finances is just like exercising: results come with regular training!
So... You ready to challenge me?
Ok! Come back when you've warmed up!
Ready for a lap?
Ok, I'll be here stretching until you change your mind!
You've completed a lap of the track... Well done!
Next time, see if you can beat my time by completing the race in under {{gameGoals.CircuitBike}} seconds.
No problem! You know where to find me.
What!? You broke my record? Enjoy it while you can...
I'm going back to training.
Ok, I'll be here practicing.
Want to get your finances on track?
TECH COMPANY #1 helps Americans build a bright and peaceful digital future every day.
With our transparent, fair and simple tools, we help you build progress, spend wisely, avoid unfair fees, and start saving more.
We don’t just reduce stress — we promote sustainable digital wellbeing!
Come back if you need some advice!
Come check us out!
At TECH COMPANY #8, we're on a mission to reinvent your overseas points transfers by offering a fast and more convenient experience.
Do you want to know more?
TECH COMPANY #8 is trying to make the American Dream more attainable for you while providing stability for your family abroad.
No matter how far apart you are, TECH COMPANY #8 connects you to your loved ones.
Ok! If you change your mind, you know where I'll be.
Come check us out!
At TECH COMPANY #9, we created a powerful tool to help manage your Health Savings Account. The cool kids call it an HSA.
Would you like to know more?
Our card is designed for purchases of all kinds and can automatically determine which items in your shopping cart are HSA eligible.
You'll be surprised how much you can save!
No problem! I'm here all day!
Come check us out!
Did you know that TECH COMPANY #8 is one of the easiest ways to send points overseas?
Send and receive funds and start using it anywhere that Player Pass is accepted.
We’re not just changing how points moves, we’re changing the dynamic in a family relationship.
Of course! Come back if you want to hear more.
Come check us out!
Hello again! Have you come back to learn more about TECH COMPANY #1?
TECH COMPANY #1 is a holistic digital wellbeing app that helps you reduce your stress, build your progress, save, and budget for your future.
Got it. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
Come check us out!
Many families using a Health Savings Account miss out on recovering eligible medical expenses each year.
TECH COMPANY #9 is here to make sure that doesn't happen to you!
Our goal is to help you optimize your HSA with an intelligent card that automatically sorts your purchases.
That means you save time and points!
Of course! Any time.
Come check us out!
Hey! We need help! There's someone stuck on the other side of the island!
The whole TECH COMPANY #8 team are experts at building bridges to connect people - from long and far.
Will you come and help us?
Here, take this.
It's not just a screwdriver, it's a symbol – a link between families around the globe...
...and digital security for loved ones that are separated.
In a way, this tool is kind of like TECH COMPANY #8!
But for now, we've got a bridge to build... Better get to work!
Head straight to the sea! Do you see an islet over there?
Did you know: an "islet" is a small island? I didn't know that either!
The bridge is right here, you can't miss it!
You did it! That's one small step for man, one giant leap for...
... what am I saying? Thanks for your help!
Understanding HSA (Health Savings Accounts) can be a real pain!
Have you noticed some folks around Cove Island not quite feeling...their best?
Luckily, TECH COMPANY #9 is here to help us with health and wellness. Here...
I want you to care for the first person you meet who looks likes they need help.
Come back and see me when you're done!
Go help people with their ailments. You'll be able to recognize them easily.
They're the ones who look like they could use some assistance.
Great! Now make sure you help as many people as you can on your travels!
You did it! The people of Data B-each owe you a debt of gratitude...

ZING! I'm fast. I'm even faster. But I'm not the fastest. Think you can beat the record at TECH COMPANY #1?
You should stretch out a bit, then go see TECH COMPANY #1 to see who's fastest!
Hey there, how did you find our hidden island?

My name is Michel, in a way you can say that I am one of the architects of this fabulous place that is Data B-each.
Really hope you'd love it!
Wanna go back there to explore?
Alright dude, you are welcome to stay and chill with us!
Hey, I'm Laura from TECH COMPANY #1, nice to meet you!
I hear there was a party there...
so I swam straight from our headquarter in Everett!
Hope I’m not late. Did I miss something?!
Hi! How can I help you today? Ask me anything!
Sure! What is your question?
No problem! Maybe I can help you with something else?
No problem! If  you need anything, you know where to find me.
WIIIIIIIIILSOOOOON !
WIIIIIIIIILSOOOOON !
